inlines.v: MYS'TIC MYS'TICAL, adjective [Latin mysticus.] Obscure; hid; secret. 1. Sacredly obscure or secret; remote from human comprehension. God hath revealed a way mystical and supernatural. 2. Involving some secret meaning; allegorical; emblematical; as mystic dance; mystic Babylon.
